context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 80 tested 3 new features: (1) Enhanced Maintenance Dashboard with monthly trends, SLA compliance, team workload, top locations at GET /api/maintenance/dashboard/{property_id}. (2) Guest QR Maintenance Reports - public endpoints for guests to report issues via QR code scan: GET /api/maintenance/guest-report-info/{property_id}/{room_id}, POST /api/maintenance/guest-report/{property_id}/{room_id}, POST /api/maintenance/guest-upload-photo/{issue_id}. Guest reports have source='guest_qr' and high priority. (3) Rate Manager - dynamic pricing with day multipliers, occupancy rules, seasons. CRUD at /api/rate-manager/plans, /api/rate-manager/seasons, calculation at POST /api/rate-manager/calculate, 30-day calendar at GET /api/rate-manager/calendar/{plan_id}. Frontend has Rate Manager panel under Operations with 3 tabs (Rate Plans, Rate Calendar, Seasons). Guest maintenance page at /room-help/{property_id}/{room_id} is mobile-optimized with category grid and photo upload.
